## Hypothesis

The 2DTE ATM premium is 2.33× higher than 0DTE, reducing tradable contracts from ~3.7 to ~1.6 and breaching the min-3-lot floor, which caused the edge_capture to fall below the OP-16 floor (759.21 < 771). Moving to ITM-1 strikes (lower premium, higher delta) or adjusting position sizing (e.g., lowering per-trade risk to allow more contracts) can restore the min-3-lot floor while preserving the VWAP continuation edge on 2DTE.

## Mechanism

Test two adjustments to the existing VWAPCONT_DTE_OVERRIDE_2DTE wiring:
1. **Strike shift:** Change `strike_offset` from 0 (ATM) to -1 (ITM-1) to reduce entry premium and increase contract count under the 50% risk cap.
2. **Position sizing:** Reduce the per-trade risk percentage (e.g., from 50% to 30%) via `max_risk_per_trade_pct` to allow more contracts at the same premium while maintaining the min-3-lot floor.
Entry trigger remains the VWAP continuation signal (`j_vwap_cont_side=both`) with DTE override to 2DTE. Exit logic remains chart-stop-primary, chandelier profit-lock (trail 0.15), and TP1 at +100% premium (sell 2/3, runner 1/3). All other parameters (e.g., premium stop, time stop) unchanged.
